slices.focus: Nadia builds a volunteer welcome-team rotation, giving caseworkers breathing room during high-arrival weeks.
slices.summary: Nadia expands the intake pilot by adding a volunteer welcome-team rotation with retired teachers and neighborhood volunteers. Volunteers handle repetitive front-end tasks (school forms, winter clothing sorting, reminder calls) while staff retain judgment work. The pilot reduces fragmentation enough that one staff member calls it 'the first high-arrival week in months that did not feel like being pecked to death by tiny urgent tasks.' Nadia plans to write a short summary with boundaries, create a tally sheet, and ask volunteers three feedback questions.
open_loops: Write short summary of volunteer rotation with 'not for volunteers' section
Create simple tally sheet for volunteer hours and task buckets
Ask volunteers three questions: what was clear, what felt confusing, what took longer than expected
Track three things: volunteer hours used, task buckets covered, staff time/same-day backlog changes
decisions: Nadia's intake pilot broadened from huddles, checklists, and school-form review into a larger workflow that now includes
